important_note: Salmeterol xinafoate is NOT formulated as an oral tablet or pill in the United States market. All US formulations are inhaled delivery systems (powder or aerosol). There are no pill/tablet physical characteristics to document as requested. This medication is exclusively available as respiratory inhalation products, either as monotherapy (Serevent Diskus) or in combination with inhaled corticosteroids (Advair products).
